notes.note: 28 touches for Serong and back to back 100+ for him. The issue is that in his previous two games were both under 90.
Best from Serong for the last three games with his 31 disposals and 14 contested possessions. If not for the low efficiency of 54% he would have put up a big score.
Serong did have 20 disposals but it was Brayshaw that had the big role this week. His price has dropped and is likely to drop further with a new BE of 132.
Serong returned this week and did have his minutes managed playing just 66% time on ground but he still had 22 disposals.
Serong was one of the four Dockers over 100 thanks to his 24 disposals as he led the game in contested possessions with 15 and led the Dockers in clearances with 6.
28 touches for Serong with his first score over 100 since round 4. He had the most clearances for the Dockers. Hopefully this is a sign of things to come.
This is now four games in a row under 100 for Serong and this is a concern because three of them have been under 90 and this was his lowest for the season.
Serong was being tagged by Lord and while he still had 22 disposals he went at just 50% due to the pressure of that tag. This was his third sub 100 score in a row.
24 touches for Serong and he had the most clearances in the game at 6. Whilst it is two under 100 in a row it wasn't by much.
Spent the second half running with Daicos and managed 24 disposals but his efficiency was just 62% in the wet. His second lowest this year. The conditions didn't suit so don't panic on him.
Serong did as he pleased with his 32 disposals with 8 tackles. He is pushing to be a part of your best 8 midfield in your Supercoach team.
Big last term for Serong where he really boosted his scoring with a couple of goals and 32 disposals to go with 6 tackles.
Serong copped the tag from Tholstrup this week after last week's big game. Just the 16 disposals which let Brayshaw off the chain. This could be a common factor during the season.
Serong top scored in the game thanks to 13 contested possessions and 30 disposals. He wasn't consistent throughout the game but he got the job done for the Dockers.
